summary.text: Pierre Whatley is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 70 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent, against Republican Melissa Stuckey.
According to Ballotpedia, Whatley replaced Diane Boulai on the general election ballot after Boulai, the winner of the Democratic primary, withdrew citing health issues.
